verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a SaaS platform like AngelList could offer telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out controls. The evidence pack documents no such setting. Account deletion (comm-8) is an adjacent control, not an opt-out. A community report that recruiters could see a user's browsing activity (comm-6) suggests tracking exists, but it shows no way to disable it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
